title: AutoCAD Productivity Suite
description: Custom .NET plugins and advanced LISP routines developed to automate repetitive civil drafting and site level coordination tasks.
details: Focused on increasing drafting efficiency by 40% through automated layer management, coordinate extraction, and batch printing utilities specifically for site layouts. Proven on multiple real-world residential and commercial site plans.
use_cases: Automating layer generation for new town planning projects. Batch processing PDF exports for client deliverables.
features: 1-Click Layer Setup, Auto-Numbering for plots, Batch Plotting Engine
impact: Reduces standard drafting setup time by 40% per project, saving ~10 hours per week.

title: Revit BIM Automation
description: A comprehensive library of pyRevit scripts designed for advanced BIM modelling, automated parameter syncing, and data-driven QA/QC.
details: Includes tools for automated Room Data Sheet generation, parameter auditing, and bulk sheet naming. Currently used to maintain model health in complex B.Tech final year college projects and site coordination.
use_cases: Synchronizing structural parameters across linked models. Generating massive sets of construction floor plans.
features: Bulk Parameter Sync, Automated Sheet Generator, Clash Sphere Placer
impact: Eliminates repetitive manual data entry, reducing a 3-day cleanup process to 15 minutes.

title: Digital PDF Flip-Book Engine
description: An interactive digital publication engine developed to convert traditional PDF documents into immersive 3D flip-books with real-time physics.
details: Engineered a custom flip-book interface using HTML/CSS/JS that simulates physical page physics and lighting. Designed to showcase technical articles and magazines in a modern, engaging digital format.
use_cases: Publishing college tech magazines, engineering reports, and digital portfolios in a highly interactive format.
features: 3D Page Flipping Physics, Dynamic Shadow Rendering, Responsive Scaling
impact: Transformed a static college magazine into an engaging web experience with 1,500+ sessions.

title: Personal Finance Tracker
description: A lightweight, secure money tracking web app designed for managing personal expenses and visualizing monthly financial trends.
details: Developed as a utility tool for students and individuals to track spending. Features include expense logging, categorical visualization, and historical data persistence via local storage/backend integration.
use_cases: Daily personal expense tracking on mobile browsers. Categorizing monthly spending for budgeting students.
features: Real-time Chart.js Visualizations, LocalStorage Persistence, Category Logging
impact: A functional tool actively used daily for personal budget management with near absolute uptime.

title: AEC Calculation Engine
description: A suite of high-precision engineering calculators integrated directly into the web, bridging structural analysis formulas with interactive UI.
details: Includes the Beam Analyzer, Gradient Solver, and Scale Converter. These tools allow site engineers to perform complex checks on-site without needing heavy desktop software, ensuring data-driven decisions on the ground.
use_cases: On-site grade verifications by surveyors. Quick simply-supported beam deflection checks for structural interns.
features: Instant Structural Feedback, Mathematical Validation Engine, Visual Deflection Curves
impact: Brings desktop-grade structural formulas natively into the browser, saving site engineers time.
